title: Local mass of a current that equals m₀[[M]] on an open set W is |m₀|·Hⁿ(M ∩ W)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), M, W ⊆ ℝ^P, m₀ ∈ ℤ and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n). Assume: W is open and W ⊆ U; M is measurable; ξ is continuous on M; for every x ∈ M there is a linear subspace Q with IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) Q (ξ(x) = ±τ₁∧⋯∧τₙ for an orthonormal basis τ of Q); Hⁿ(M ∩ W) < ∞, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]; and T(ω) = m₀ ∫_M ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n) with tsupport ω ⊆ W. Then the local mass satisfies M_W(T) = T.massOn W = |m₀|·Hⁿ(M ∩ W) in [0, ∞] (with |m₀| = m₀.natAbs).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M W : Set (Euclid P)) (m₀ : ℤ) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → MeasurableSet M → ContinuousOn ξ M → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) Q) → μHE[n] (M ∩ W) ≠ ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ W → T ω = m₀ * ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → T.massOn W = (m₀.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[n] (M ∩ W)
